Bound live-e2e probe pipe drains after exit

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-1
  description: |-
    Keep draining probe stdout/stderr concurrently under one wall-clock deadline while retaining only a fixed trailing diagnostic window. If pipes do not reach EOF before the budget expires, terminate the owned process group and abort the drain tasks so sustained output or a descendant holding inherited fds cannot exhaust memory or hang the harness.
